source.stem: Which is a non-renewable energy resource?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The glass bulb, not the filament, produces the light.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The disconnected lamp will glow because its filament is intact.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: This lamp is fused because it is not glowing.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: An LED cannot glow because it has no filament.

intelligence.enrichment: In an incandescent electric lamp, the thin wire inside the glass bulb is the filament that glows; if the filament is broken, the lamp is fused and will not glow. filament condition + current through lamp -> filament glows or lamp stays off The learner correctly applies this rule: In an incandescent electric lamp, the thin wire inside the glass bulb is the filament that glows; if the filament is broken, the lamp is fused and will not glow. A torch lamp glows if the outside glass bulb looks whole; the filament is just a visible detail.
